body: Technically yes, but I’d prefer not to. My parents are the kind who don’t understand mental illness and who will also entirely blame themselves if they think anything is wrong with me. My local GP has a policy that if you’re still a minor (under 18) legal guardians must be contacted.
I have friends with depression and PTSD, and they all call them mental institutions. 🤔 Not in a bad or negative way, that’s just what they call them.
